Independent review of run r-20260925T115355281795-s17-lane-cycle-runbook, reviewed base c2901ec5dbb8a3bc03314b72b3596ef7b68a5566 and reviewed head c79d278c41b2718978ae27a3d0a754acf82cef8e.

The live plan requires ops/lane-cycle/AGENTS.md to state each of the seven cycle steps with an exact command, the 15-minute readiness bound from RUNNING, rollback, the pause bound and the router-restart distinction; it also requires links to resolve and keeps the operational cycle coordinator-owned. I read that section before the target manifest and then audited the target commit, its changed files, the recorded help transcript, the ruff receipt, the classifier and profile references used by the runbook, the evidence anchor and the figure.

VERDICT goal: c79d278c implements the router-pause cycle with measured drain classification, main-checkout relaunch, real completion validation, rollback and resume. The engine-relaunch/router-restart distinction is explicit and operational actions remain coordinator-owned. Steps 1 and 7 are prose/pseudo-invocation rather than executable commands, so the exact-command done-when is not fully met.
VERDICT done_when: the seven-step runbook, bounds, rollback, help provenance, links and figure are present. The dry-run safety check at ops/lane-cycle/AGENTS.md:94 is `uv run ... --dry-run | grep -c ...`; without pipefail or explicit capture, a failing uv command can still produce grep's zero and falsely pass the required no-worktree assertion. The announcement at lines 35-48 has no concrete notification command, and recording at lines 157-170 has no command for writing the cycle record.
VERDICT write_paths: git diff --name-status c2901ec5..c79d278c reports exactly the seven paths declared by the worker; the changes are scoped to operational guidance, plan/evidence landing and one figure.
VERDICT manifest: the target manifest accurately reports c79d278c, its paths, the green ruff log, the four help screens and that no pause/resume/restart/shutdown was executed. Its disclosed follow-on is confirmed: the reviewed evidence file's plan-verifies meta at line 13 omits local-lane-admission-control#s17 even though the new evidence section is present.
VERDICT evidence: the help blocks match the CLI option surfaces in the reviewed tree; classify_reading returns measured/stale/unavailable from the stamped lane document and the profile serves on port 18810 with max_total_tokens 4000000. The run's live probe honestly measured running=13, so it is evidence that the instrument works, not a fabricated successful drain.
VERDICT fit: the new directory-scoped guidance and loader, root/component pointers and project-absolute figure follow repository conventions and preserve cumulative evidence. The missing executable steps and shell false-zero path are operational reliability defects, not scope violations.

JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: The mechanism and coordinator boundary match the plan; exact commands are missing for announcement and recording.
SCORE evidence: 16
JUSTIFICATION evidence: Help and source-backed measurements are present and honest, but the dry-run check can false-pass and s17 is absent from the evidence archive's plan-verifies metadata.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: Exactly seven intended paths changed and no operational action or unrelated code was touched.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: The committed run and on-disk receipts are durable and traceable; the procedural receipt still has the metadata and shell-check weaknesses above.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: The scoped runbook architecture is appropriate and illustrated; the incomplete exact-command surface and false-zero guard prevent full credit.
